name: 10 — Performance: 50 Users (Direct Path)
description:
Performance test with 50 concurrent users, 3 messages each (150 total requests).

🔧 Gateway Config:
• Token: test-gateway-token-12345
• NO app assigned → Direct path (bypasses Temporal)
• Governance Profile: 'mock'
  - No rate limits
  - No guardrails
  - Logging: minimal (metrics only)

📊 Performance Target:
• Expected latency: ~300-500ms
• Expected success: 100%

🔧 Path: Direct (no Temporal) — bypasses AppFlow workflows
